name: EnvScaler
title: EnvScaler: Scaling Tool-Interactive Environments for LLM Agent via Programmatic Synthesis
summary_en: Mines topics into stateful Python environment skeletons, then generates initial states, tasks and rule-based validators for SFT/RL.
summary_zh: 从主题挖掘出有状态的 Python 环境骨架，再生成初始状态、任务与基于规则的校验函数，用于 SFT/RL。

name: AgentScaler
title: Towards General Agentic Intelligence via Environment Scaling
summary_en: Automatically constructs fully simulated, heterogeneous function-calling environments and trains agents with a two-phase fine-tuning recipe.
summary_zh: 自动构建完全模拟的异构函数调用环境，并以两阶段微调训练 Agent。

name: AutoForge
title: AutoForge: Automated Environment Synthesis for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Unified pipeline synthesizing simulated environments with hard-but-verifiable tasks, plus an environment-level RL algorithm robust to user-simulator noise.
summary_zh: 统一流水线合成带高难度、易验证任务的模拟环境，并提出对模拟用户噪声鲁棒的环境级 RL 算法。

name: AWM
title: Agent World Model: Infinity Synthetic Environments for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: LLM writes DB schema, data, API spec, MCP server code and SQL verifiers from seed scenarios, yielding SQLite-backed executable environments.
summary_zh: 由 LLM 从种子场景依次生成库表、数据、API 规范、MCP 服务代码与 SQL 校验器，得到 SQLite 支撑的可执行环境。

name: ScaleEnv
title: ScaleEnv: Scaling Environment Synthesis from Scratch for Generalist Interactive Tool-Use Agent Training
summary_en: Builds interactive environments from scratch with procedural testing, and guarantees task solvability via tool-dependency-graph expansion and action verification.
summary_zh: 从零构建交互环境并以程序化测试保证可靠性，通过工具依赖图扩展与动作执行验证保证任务可解。

name: EnvFactory
title: EnvFactory: Scaling Tool-Use Agents via Executable Environments Synthesis and Robust RL
summary_en: Search, coding and testing agents build verified stateful MCP environments from real resources; topology-aware sampling creates implicit-intent tasks.
summary_zh: 搜索/编码/测试三类 Agent 基于真实资源构建经验证的有状态 MCP 环境，拓扑感知采样生成隐式意图任务。

name: Agent-World
title: Agent-World: Scaling Real-World Environment Synthesis for Evolving General Agent Intelligence
summary_en: Agentically discovers databases and executable tool ecosystems from real MCP themes, then co-evolves environments and policy via self-evolving RL.
summary_zh: 以 Agent 方式从真实 MCP 主题中发掘数据库与可执行工具生态，并通过自进化 RL 让环境与策略共同演化。

name: CompoWorld
title: CompoWorld: Compositional Environment Scaling for General Agents
summary_en: Coding agents implement MCP tool specs as typed, verified services, and random walks compose cross-service verifiable tasks.
summary_zh: 编码 Agent 将 MCP 工具规范实现为带类型状态、经验证的服务，再通过随机游走组合跨服务的可验证任务。

name: ToolVerse
title: ToolVerse: Unlocking Massive Environments and Long-Horizon Tasks for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary_en: Rewrites real MCP tool schemas into mock-database executable environments and samples long-horizon tasks by dynamic unlocking on dependency graphs.
summary_zh: 把真实 MCP 工具定义改写为带模拟数据库的可执行环境，在依赖图上以动态解锁采样生成长程任务。

name: RandomWorld
title: Procedural Environment Generation for Tool-Use Agents
summary_en: Procedurally generates typed synthetic tools and composes non-linear tool-call DAGs into interactive environments for online RL and SFT.
summary_zh: 基于类型体系程序化生成合成工具，并组合成非线性工具调用 DAG，构成用于在线 RL 与 SFT 的交互环境。

name: PROVE
title: Synthesize and Reward -- Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Step Tool Use in Live Environments
summary_en: Session-isolated stateful MCP servers plus a state-machine pipeline that synthesizes tasks grounded in live server state with programmatic rewards.
summary_zh: 会话隔离的有状态 MCP 服务，配合状态机流水线基于实时服务状态合成任务并给出程序化奖励。

name: Simia
title: Simulating Environments with Reasoning Models for Agent Training
summary_en: Reasoning LLMs simulate environment feedback from tool schemas without real APIs, amplifying SFT trajectories and serving as RL environments.
summary_zh: 推理模型依据工具定义直接模拟环境反馈，无需真实 API，既扩增 SFT 轨迹又充当 RL 环境。

name: TRUSTEE
title: Democratizing Tool Learning with Environments Fully Simulated by a Free 8B Language Model
summary_en: An open 8B LM simulates the full environment, including tasks, users, tools and judging, with an adaptive curriculum for tool-use RL.
summary_zh: 用开源 8B 模型模拟完整环境（任务、用户、工具与评判），配合自适应课程进行工具调用 RL。

name: SynthAgent
title: Mock Worlds, Real Skills: Building Small Agentic Language Models with Synthetic Tasks, Simulated Environments, and Rubric-Based Rewards
summary_en: A teacher LLM synthesizes tasks and tool ecosystems, then serves mock tools and simulated users with rubric-based rewards for RL.
summary_zh: 教师模型合成任务与工具生态，并以模拟工具、模拟用户和 rubric 奖励支撑 RL 训练。

name: SynthTools
title: SynthTools: A Framework for Scaling Synthetic Tools for Agent Development
summary_en: Hierarchically generates domain tool environments, simulates and audits tools with LLMs, and builds verifiable tasks with initial/final states.
summary_zh: 分层生成各领域工具环境，用 LLM 模拟并审计工具，构造带初始/终止状态的可验证任务。

name: GTM
title: GTM: Simulating the World of Tools for AI Agents
summary_en: Trains a 1.5B universal tool simulator that replaces real tool execution during agent RL via prompt-level configuration.
summary_zh: 训练 1.5B 通用工具模拟器，仅靠提示配置即可在 Agent RL 中替代真实工具执行。

name: MirrorAPI
title: StableToolBench-MirrorAPI: Modeling Tool Environments as Mirrors of 7,000+ Real-World APIs
summary_en: Fine-tunes LLMs on real request-response pairs to act as high-fidelity mirrors of real APIs for tool environments.
summary_zh: 用真实请求-响应对微调 LLM，使其成为真实 API 的高保真镜像工具环境。

name: Qwen-AgentWorld
title: Qwen-AgentWorld: Language World Models for General Agents
summary_en: Trains language world models that predict next environment states across seven domains, used as controllable simulators for agentic RL.
summary_zh: 训练预测 7 类环境下一状态的语言世界模型，作为 Agentic RL 的可控模拟器。

name: DreamGym
title: Scaling Agent Learning via Experience Synthesis
summary_en: Distills environment dynamics into a reasoning-based experience model that generates transitions and rewards, with adaptive task generation for RL.
summary_zh: 把环境动力学蒸馏为基于推理的经验模型来生成状态转移与奖励，并自适应生成任务用于 RL。

name: Simulate-to-Generalize
title: Simulate to Generalize: Scaling Stateful Supervision for API-calling Agents using LLM World Models
summary_en: From domain names, synthesizes APIs and tasks; an LLM world model tracks state and returns API responses to produce stateful trajectories.
summary_zh: 仅从领域名称合成 API 与任务，由 LLM 世界模型跟踪状态并返回 API 响应，产出有状态轨迹。

name: SWE-Gym
title: Training Software Engineering Agents and Verifiers with SWE-Gym
summary_en: Pairs real GitHub issues with pre-installed executable runtimes and unit-test verification for training SWE agents and verifiers.
summary_zh: 将真实 GitHub issue 与预装依赖的可执行运行时、单元测试验证结合，用于训练 SWE Agent 与验证器。

name: R2E-Gym
title: R2E-Gym: Procedural Environments and Hybrid Verifiers for Scaling Open-Weights SWE Agents
summary_en: Curates executable environments directly from commits via test generation and issue back-translation, without relying on human-written issues.
summary_zh: 通过测试生成与 issue 反向翻译，直接从 commit 程序化构建可执行环境，不依赖人工 issue。

name: SWE-smith
title: SWE-smith: Scaling Data for Software Engineering Agents
summary_en: Builds one environment per repo, then synthesizes test-breaking bugs via LM rewrites, AST mutations, PR reversal and bug combination.
summary_zh: 每个仓库只建一个环境，再通过 LM 改写、AST 变异、回退 PR 等方式合成使测试失败的 bug。

name: SWE-Synth
title: SWE-Synth: Synthesizing Verifiable Bug-Fix Data to Enable Large Language Models in Resolving Real-World Bugs
summary_en: LLM agents simulate debugging workflows to synthesize verifiable repository-level bug-fix pairs, tests and repair trajectories.
summary_zh: LLM Agent 模拟调试流程，合成可验证的仓库级 bug 修复对、测试用例与修复轨迹。

name: SWE-rebench
title: SWE-rebench: An Automated Pipeline for Task Collection and Decontaminated Evaluation of Software Engineering Agents
summary_en: Fully automated mining of GitHub PRs with LLM-generated install recipes and execution-based validation, yielding RL-ready SWE tasks.
summary_zh: 全自动挖掘 GitHub PR，由 LLM 生成安装配置并经执行验证，产出可直接用于 RL 的 SWE 任务。

name: SWE-rebench V2
title: SWE-rebench V2: Language-Agnostic SWE Task Collection at Scale
summary_en: An interactive setup agent synthesizes repo-specific install and test procedures across 20 languages, with LLM-judge filtering.
summary_zh: 交互式配置 Agent 为 20 种语言的仓库合成安装与测试流程，并以 LLM 评审过滤。

name: Repo2Run
title: Repo2Run: Automated Building Executable Environment for Code Repository at Scale
summary_en: An LLM agent iteratively builds Docker images with rollback and unit-test checks, synthesizing runnable Dockerfiles for arbitrary repos.
summary_zh: LLM Agent 迭代构建 Docker 镜像（可回滚）并运行单测，为任意仓库合成可运行的 Dockerfile。

name: RepoLaunch
title: RepoLaunch: Automating Build and Management of Code Repositories across Languages and Platforms
summary_en: Agentic framework that resolves dependencies, compiles and extracts test results across languages and OSes for automated SWE task generation.
summary_zh: 跨语言、跨操作系统自动解决依赖、编译并抽取测试结果，驱动全自动 SWE 任务生成。

name: SWE-Factory
title: SWE-Factory: Your Automated Factory for Issue Resolution Training Data and Evaluation Benchmarks
summary_en: Multi-agent builder generates Dockerfiles and eval scripts with an environment memory pool; exit-code grading automates fail-to-pass validation.
summary_zh: 多智能体借助环境记忆池自动生成 Dockerfile 与评测脚本，以退出码判分自动完成 fail-to-pass 验证。

name: SWE-Flow
title: SWE-Flow: Synthesizing Software Engineering Data in a Test-Driven Manner
summary_en: Builds runtime dependency graphs from unit tests to derive incremental TDD steps, each with a partial codebase and verifiable tests.
summary_zh: 由单元测试构建运行时依赖图，推导增量开发步骤，每步包含部分代码库与可验证测试。

name: Skywork-SWE
title: Skywork-SWE: Unveiling Data Scaling Laws for Software Engineering in LLMs
summary_en: Incremental automated pipeline building per-instance runtime images with unit-test validation across thousands of Python repositories.
summary_zh: 增量式自动流水线，为数千个 Python 仓库逐实例构建带单测验证的运行时镜像。

name: SWE-Mirror
title: SWE-Mirror: Scaling Issue-Resolving Datasets by Mirroring Issues Across Repositories
summary_en: Distills real issues and re-instantiates them in repos that already have Gym environments, reusing environments to scale tasks.
summary_zh: 提炼真实 issue 语义并移植到已有环境的仓库中，复用环境以扩充任务。

name: BugPilot
title: BugPilot: Complex Bug Generation for Efficient Learning of SWE Skills
summary_en: SWE agents implement new features that unintentionally break tests, yielding realistic, complex and verifiable training bugs.
summary_zh: 让 SWE Agent 开发新功能并无意间破坏测试，得到更真实、更复杂且可验证的训练 bug。

name: RepoForge
title: RepoForge: Training a SOTA Fast-thinking SWE Agent with an End-to-End Data Curation Pipeline Synergizing SFT and RL at Scale
summary_en: Autonomously generates executable environments from GitHub commits with storage-efficient image pruning and distributed evaluation for RL.
summary_zh: 从 GitHub commit 零人工生成可执行环境，配合镜像裁剪与分布式评测支撑 RL。

name: SSR
title: Toward Training Superintelligent Software Agents through Self-Play SWE-RL
summary_en: A single policy self-plays bug injection and repair in sandboxed repos, with bugs specified by agent-proposed test patches.
summary_zh: 同一策略在沙箱仓库中自博弈地注入与修复 bug，bug 由 Agent 自行提出的测试补丁定义。

name: SWE-Playground
title: Training Versatile Coding Agents in Synthetic Environments
summary_en: LLM agents synthesize entire projects, task decompositions, scaffolds and unit tests from scratch, without existing repositories.
summary_zh: 由 LLM Agent 从零生成完整项目、任务拆分、代码骨架与单元测试，不依赖现有仓库。

name: SWE-Universe
title: SWE-Universe: Scale Real-World Verifiable Environments to Millions
summary_en: A trained building agent synthesizes environments and verifiers from PRs, with buggy/fixed self-verification and in-loop hacking detection.
summary_zh: 专门训练的构建 Agent 从 PR 合成环境与验证脚本，并进行 buggy/fixed 自校验与作弊检测。

name: Endless Terminals
title: Endless Terminals: Scaling RL Environments for Terminal Agents
summary_en: Fully autonomous pipeline generating terminal tasks, validated containers, completion tests and solvability filters for RL.
summary_zh: 全自动生成终端任务、经验证的容器、完成态测试，并按可解性过滤，用于 RL。

name: TermiGen
title: TermiGen: High-Fidelity Environment and Robust Trajectory Synthesis for Terminal Agents
summary_en: Multi-agent refinement loop generates verified tasks and Docker containers; a generator-critic protocol injects errors for recovery-rich trajectories.
summary_zh: 多智能体迭代生成经验证的任务与 Docker 容器，生成器-评审者协议主动注入错误以合成富含纠错的轨迹。

name: TerminalTraj
title: Large-Scale Terminal Agentic Trajectory Generation from Dockerized Environments
summary_en: Filters repositories with model scoring, builds Dockerized environments, and generates aligned terminal tasks with executable validators.
summary_zh: 以模型打分筛选仓库并构建 Docker 环境，生成对齐的终端任务与逐实例可执行验证代码。

name: Nemotron-Terminal
title: On Data Engineering for Scaling LLM Terminal Capabilities
summary_en: Seed- and skill-based terminal task generation executed in Dockerized environments, with a systematic study of terminal data engineering.
summary_zh: 基于种子与技能的终端任务生成并在 Docker 环境中执行，系统研究终端数据工程策略。

name: Terminal-World
title: Terminal-World: Scaling Terminal-Agent Environments via Agent Skills
summary_en: Uses agent skills as the synthesis primitive to co-derive instructions, environments, verifiers and teacher trajectories.
summary_zh: 以 Agent 技能为合成单元，同时推导任务指令、环境、验证器与教师轨迹。

name: SETA
title: SETA: Scaling Environments for Terminal Agents
summary_en: Converts diverse sources into standardized RL environments, then evolves them with adaptive difficulty under unified verification.
summary_zh: 将多种来源转换为标准化 RL 环境，并在统一验证下自适应调整难度、演化扩充。

name: LiteCoder-Terminal
title: LiteCoder-Terminal: Scaling Long-Horizon Terminal Environments for Learning Language Agents
summary_en: Zero-dependency pipeline synthesizing executable, verifiable long-horizon terminal environments directly from domain specifications.
summary_zh: 不依赖外部仓库，直接从领域规格合成可执行、可验证的长程终端环境。

name: Envs-FORGE
title: Envs-FORGE: Frontier-Optimized Reward-Grounded Environment Synthesis for Agent RL
summary_en: Turns verifier pass rates into MILP-selected synthesis actions that rewrite instructions, tests and Docker environments toward the learning frontier.
summary_zh: 将验证通过率转化为 MILP 选择的合成动作，改写指令、测试与 Docker 环境，使难度贴近学习前沿。

name: InfiniteWeb
title: InfiniteWeb: Scalable Web Environment Synthesis for GUI Agent Training
summary_en: Generates functional websites via unified specs and task-centric test-driven development, with auto-generated evaluators for GUI RL.
summary_zh: 通过统一规格与以任务为中心的测试驱动开发生成可用网站，并自动生成评估器用于 GUI RL。

name: AutoWebWorld
title: AutoWebWorld: Synthesizing Infinite Verifiable Web Environments via Finite State Machines
summary_en: Models websites as finite state machines and code-generates web environments whose FSM states make task success verifiable.
summary_zh: 将网站建模为有限状态机并据此生成网页环境，由 FSM 状态判定任务成功。

name: VeriEnv
title: Safe and Scalable Web Agent Learning via Recreated Websites
summary_en: Coding agents recreate real websites as executable sandboxes with database access, enabling programmatically verifiable tasks.
summary_zh: 编码 Agent 将真实网站复刻为可访问数据库的可执行沙盒，支持可程序化验证的任务。

name: Weblica
title: Weblica: Scalable and Reproducible Training Environments for Visual Web Agents
summary_en: Builds reproducible web environments from LLM-synthesized sites and cached real pages, with generated tasks and verifiers.
summary_zh: 以 LLM 合成站点与缓存真实网页构建可复现 Web 环境，并生成任务与验证器。

name: ScaleWoB
title: ScaleWoB: Guiding GUI Agents with Coding Agents via Large-Scale Environmental Synthesis
summary_en: Coding agents synthesize interactive web and mobile apps with verifiable tasks at scale for GUI agent training.
summary_zh: 编码 Agent 大规模合成可交互的网页与移动 App 及可验证任务，用于 GUI Agent 训练。

name: MAI-Gym
title: MAI-Gym: An Open All-in-One Platform for GUI Agent Evaluation and RL Training across Mobile and Computer Environments
summary_en: Synthesizes mocked mobile and desktop apps with state-checkable tasks via a diagnose-then-synthesize loop targeting agent weaknesses.
summary_zh: 以“诊断后合成”循环针对 Agent 弱点合成带状态检查任务的模拟移动端与桌面 App。

name: Echoverse
title: Echoverse: Deep, Evolving Environments for Training Computer-Use Agents at Scale
summary_en: Agent-built deep, stateful computer-use environments that keep evolving alongside the policy, producing verified trajectories.
summary_zh: 由 Agent 构建的深层有状态电脑操作环境，随策略持续演化并产出经验证的轨迹。

name: PhoneWorld
title: PhoneWorld: From Real-App Trajectories to Dynamic and Verifiable Environments for Phone-Use Agents
summary_en: Converts real-app trajectories into rebuilt dynamic Android apps with backend state, enabling verifiable phone-use RL tasks.
summary_zh: 把真实 App 轨迹转化为带后端状态的重建 Android App，支持可验证的手机操作 RL 任务。

name: UI-Simulator
title: LLMs as Scalable, General-Purpose Simulators For Evolving Digital Agent Training
summary_en: An LLM acts as a world simulator generating UI state transitions, forming virtual digital environments for trajectory collection.
summary_zh: 让 LLM 充当世界模拟器生成 UI 状态转移，构成用于轨迹采集的虚拟数字环境。

name: WebSynthesis
title: WebSynthesis: World-Model-Guided MCTS for Efficient WebUI-Trajectory Synthesis
summary_en: A learned web world model serves as a virtual environment; MCTS over it synthesizes WebUI trajectories without live websites.
summary_zh: 以学习到的 Web 世界模型作为虚拟环境，在其上做 MCTS 合成 WebUI 轨迹，无需真实网站。

name: AutoEnv
title: AutoEnv: Automated Environments for Measuring Cross-Environment Agent Learning
summary_en: Factorizes environments into transitions, observations and rewards so LLMs can generate heterogeneous executable worlds at low cost.
summary_zh: 将环境分解为状态转移、观测与奖励，使 LLM 能低成本生成异构的可执行世界。

name: AgentGen
title: AgentGen: Enhancing Planning Abilities for Large Language Model based Agent via Environment and Task Generation
summary_en: LLMs generate diverse PDDL/code environments from an inspiration corpus, then evolve tasks bidirectionally for controllable difficulty.
summary_zh: LLM 以灵感语料为种子生成多样的 PDDL/代码环境，再以双向演化生成难度可控的规划任务。

name: GenEnv
title: GenEnv: Difficulty-Aligned Co-Evolution Between LLM Agents and Environment Simulators
summary_en: An LLM environment simulator generates tasks aligned to the agent's current difficulty, co-evolving with the agent through RL.
summary_zh: LLM 环境模拟器按 Agent 当前能力生成难度匹配的任务，并与 Agent 在 RL 中共同进化。

name: EmboMatrix
title: EmboMatrix: A Scalable Training-Ground for Embodied Decision-Making
summary_en: Multi-agent data engine generates embodied tasks and simulated scenes with multi-level rewards for LLM embodied RL.
summary_zh: 多智能体数据引擎生成具身任务与仿真场景，配合多层级奖励进行 LLM 具身 RL。

name: Reasoning Gym
title: Reasoning Gym: Reasoning Environments for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary_en: Library of 100+ procedural generators with verifiers over algebra, logic, games and graphs for unlimited, difficulty-controllable RLVR data.
summary_zh: 100 多个带验证器的程序化生成器，覆盖代数、逻辑、游戏、图等，可无限生成难度可控的 RLVR 数据。

name: Enigmata
title: Enigmata: Scaling Logical Reasoning in Large Language Models with Synthetic Verifiable Puzzles
summary_en: Puzzle suite pairing each task with an unlimited, difficulty-controllable generator and a rule-based verifier for multi-task RLVR.
summary_zh: 每类谜题均配有可无限生成、难度可控的生成器与规则验证器，用于多任务 RLVR。

name: SynLogic
title: SynLogic: Synthesizing Verifiable Reasoning Data at Scale for Learning Logical Reasoning and Beyond
summary_en: Synthesizes 35 logical reasoning task types with adjustable difficulty and rule-based verifiers, directly usable for RLVR.
summary_zh: 合成 35 类难度可调、带规则验证器的逻辑推理任务，可直接用于 RLVR。

name: InternBootcamp
title: InternBootcamp: Boosting LLM Reasoning with Verifiable Task Scaling
summary_en: Agent workflow auto-generates 1,000+ bootcamp environments, each with instance generator and verifier, for scalable verifiable-task RL.
summary_zh: Agent 工作流自动生成 1000 多个 Bootcamp 环境（含实例生成器与验证器），用于大规模可验证任务 RL。

name: Reasoning Core
title: Reasoning Core: A Scalable Procedural Data Generation Suite for Symbolic Pre-training and Post-Training
summary_en: Procedural generators over planning, logic, grammars and probabilistic inference, verified by external solvers with continuous difficulty control.
summary_zh: 覆盖规划、逻辑、文法与概率推断的程序化生成器，由外部求解器验证，难度连续可调。

name: KORGym
title: KORGym: A Dynamic Game Platform for LLM Reasoning Evaluation
summary_en: Gym-style platform of 50+ procedurally parameterized text and visual games supporting multi-turn interaction and RL.
summary_zh: Gym 风格平台，包含 50 多个参数化生成的文本/视觉游戏，支持多轮交互与 RL。

name: RLVE
title: RLVE: Scaling Up Reinforcement Learning for Language Models with Adaptive Verifiable Environments
summary_en: 400 procedural verifiable environments whose problem difficulty adapts to the policy's capability during RL.
summary_zh: 400 个程序化可验证环境，题目难度在 RL 过程中随策略能力自适应调整。

name: ReSyn
title: ReSyn: Autonomously Scaling Synthetic Environments for Reasoning Models
summary_en: LLM pipeline autonomously writes instance generators and verifiers for diverse reasoning environments to scale RLVR.
summary_zh: LLM 流水线自动为多样推理环境编写实例生成器与验证器，以扩展 RLVR。

name: EvoEnv
title: Learning to Build the Environment: Self-Evolving Reasoning RL via Verifiable Environment Synthesis
summary_en: The policy itself synthesizes new verifiable Python environments from seeds, co-evolving environment building and reasoning in one RL loop.
summary_zh: 策略模型从种子环境出发自行合成新的可验证 Python 环境，在同一 RL 循环中协同提升环境构建与推理能力。
